findings.evidence: docs/modules/auth/use-cases/register-account.md Main Flow Step 5 states 'System (client) | On success, router.push("/plans").' and AC-1 states 'Then a new account is created and they are redirected to /plans', both grounded in the same src/app/register/page.tsx file cited by first-time-signup.md.
findings.locationHint: 4. **Session-aware landing**: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] The exact client-side navigation performed by `src/app/register/page.tsx` immediately after a successful `signIn` call is not established by the grounded module docs. What is established is that finance-planner's root route (`src/app/page.tsx`, `docs/modules/web-ui/overview.md`) is a server component that calls `getServerSession(authOptions)` and redirects to `/plans` when a session exists, or to `/login` otherwise — so once the new session is active, navigating to `/` (or being routed there) lands the user on `/plans`.
findings.message: This step asserts the post-signIn client-side navigation in src/app/register/page.tsx is unestablished, but the sibling doc docs/modules/auth/use-cases/register-account.md (Step 5 and AC-1), grounded in the same file, explicitly documents it as `router.push("/plans")` - a direct contradiction between the two generated docs on the same fact.

findings.evidence: docs/modules/auth/use-cases/register-account.md's Error Handling table documents 'Invalid input (400): UI displays data.error text (or fallback "Registration failed")' and 'Duplicate email (409): UI displays the returned error text', with matching Alternative Flows AF-1 (validation failure) and AF-2 (email already exists) describing exactly this error-path UI behavior for POST /api/auth/register.
